title: Editing Records, Citations & Uploading Scans
style: Warm, clear archival museum narrator at a calm, unhurried pace.

steps.title: Create or edit records with source attribution
steps.posterAlt: Person Profile in editor mode showing the Edit Page drawer and citation attribution controls.

cues.text: Signed-in editors can select Edit Page on any Person Profile, Place Profile, or event to refine dates, biographies, and Family Notes.
Attach a primary citation whenever available, or mark oral history clearly as Family memory before saving.

steps.title: Resolve Edit Conflicts and review Revision History
steps.posterAlt: Revision History page listing versioned archival edits with field-level diff previews and revert controls.

cues.text: If two editors update the same record at once, Kinloom opens the Conflict Merge dialog so no work is silently overwritten.
Open Revision History at any time to inspect field-level diffs and safely revert an earlier revision.

steps.title: Upload Photos & Documents under the Living Privacy Rule
steps.posterAlt: Photos and Documents gallery illustrating portrait, headstone, and document scan categories.

cues.text: Upload portraits, family photographs, headstones, and document scans directly from any deceased ancestor's Person Profile.
To protect living relatives, Kinloom enforces the Living Privacy Rule and blocks public portrait uploads for living individuals.
